about: Every result file the manuscript compiles from, the grid job that wrote it, and what it is. A number in the paper resolves to file#pointer through numbers_manifest.json, and the file resolves to a job here.

D4_mgmt.json.what: MGMT-STP27 per array, with the flip distance and the observed recurrence shift.

HC2_benchlists_criterion.json.what: The fraction-confound criterion under every published cross-species probe-exclusion list.

HC2_dmp_counts_all_splits.json.what: Probes at p < 0.001 for all ten balanced splits, per pipeline and design.

L1_lump.json.what: The LUMP lever check per array: the test of whether the array betas read the human compartment only.

M2_HM1_summary.json.what: Recurrent-minus-primary tumour share on each platform, with exact 90 % intervals and the labelling rank.

S1_smin.json.what: The detection bound: the smallest share of recurrent cells carrying a shared single-copy change that would be flagged.

T3_fcpg.json.what: Fluctuating-CpG homogeneity with its two pre-stated gates.

T4_S1.json.what: Convergence of derived arm-level copy-number change, and the smallest shared subclone the rule would detect.

c1.json.what: Arm-level copy number in the contralateral sample against its own core and the culture, with the noise bound.

c3_ha2_ha3.json.what: Species-blind differential expression over all ten balanced splits; H-A2 and H-A3.

c3_splits_summary.json.what: Differentially expressed genes per split, with each split's difference in tumour share.

c4_categories_by_view.json.what: The three pre-stated GO categories across four views, Holm across 3 x 4.

c5_l2_t1r.json.what: GSVA mesenchymal scores with the dilution null, the ESTIMATE lever check, and the DiG robustness scorings.

c6_summary.json.what: The fraction-covariate model: collinearity, variance inflation, and how many tumour-cell changes it recovers.

composition_S1.json.what: Sensitivity S1: the same decomposition on graft-only reads (nf-core/rnaseq 3.22.2 re-quantification).

composition_S4.json.what: Sensitivity S4: the same decomposition over HCOP one-to-one orthologs instead of Compara 110.

composition_main.json.what: Species-blind virtual bulk, exact mixing identity and Shapley decomposition; the primary endpoint.

composition_samples_main.json.what: Per-library tumour shares on every definition, and human chromosome Y per million human counts.

criteria.json.what: The contralateral case: the pre-registered statistics against the depth-matched dilution null.

dilution_tests.json.what: Copy-number amplitude, MGMT promoter mean and fCpG index against the in-silico dilution nulls (UNVALIDATED).

e2_chrY.json.what: Human chromosome Y counts per million human counts, per library.

e3_N2_correlations.json.what: Bin-profile correlation of the contralateral array with the core and the culture.

estimates.json.what: Each array read on the titration curve, raw and mixture-corrected.

fdna_resolved.json.what: Every tumour DNA fraction estimate per array, with which one is registered and which gates it passed.

l2_estimate_scores.json.what: ESTIMATE stromal, immune and combined scores on the virtual bulk.

m3_rna_vs_dna.json.what: RNA share against DNA fraction per lesion, and the cell-share range under two DNA indexes.

m4_host.json.what: Host deconvolution by three published methods with the pre-stated ordering, agreement and athymic controls.

m4_lesion_accounting.json.what: Per-lesion accounting: tumour share plus host cell-type terms, summing to read composition.

power_closed_only.json.what: The pre-stated targets of the scaled experiment and the animals each needs, closed-form.

t1_e1.json.what: The distal-invasion (DiG) programme, fraction-adjusted, over the twenty labellings; and the abandoned E1 gate.

t2.json.what: Allelic imbalance in species-exact human reads, its gates and its thinning null.

validation.json.what: The human:mouse titration that the in-silico mixing had to reproduce, and its failure against the pre-set bar.

xengsort_classes.json.what: Read pairs per library assigned graft, host, both, ambiguous or neither.
